findings.feminine_pair: Blind target matches human-confirmed feminine phrase. Frozen transcript unchanged. Exact matches, altered differs; both quote feminine.
findings.date: Blind target matches human confirmation. Comparison accepts first September against reference numeral 1 before September.
findings.word_boundary: Fails spoken-form comparison: differs based on lexical meanings of written потому versus по тому, without support for different sounds. No human acoustic gold for W5.
findings.format: All four comparison responses wrap JSON in Markdown fences. Original output retained; exact outer fence removed offline, no retries.

limitations: Only target phrases W3/W4 are human confirmed, not neighbouring words or entire recording.
Blind transcript is a second recognition hypothesis, not acoustic ground truth.
Text comparison cannot recover pronunciation, stress or omitted sounds absent from its input.
Single attempt per condition; no reliability rate inferred.
Independent transcript frozen across variants prevents retroactive substitution but does not guarantee correct recognition.
cost_method: Usage estimate, not invoice; no cached tokens; reasoning included in output total.
